eligibilityQuestions.text: Is your business established in Great Britain (England, Scotland, or Wales)?
Are you moving goods from GB to Northern Ireland (not GB to Republic of Ireland)?
Are the goods "at risk" of being moved from Northern Ireland into the EU?
Are the goods intended for final sale to end consumers in Northern Ireland (B2C)?

not-gb-established.message: UKIMS is only available to businesses established in Great Britain. Republic of Ireland or EU-based traders are not eligible.

wrong-route.message: The Windsor Framework green lane applies only to GB→NI movements. Goods moving GB→Ireland or NI→GB use different arrangements.

at-risk.message: Goods at risk of onward movement into the EU must use the red lane and full customs procedures.

b2c-eligible.message: Your goods qualify for the Windsor Framework green lane (B2C). You can move them under the Internal Market Scheme without full customs declarations.

b2b-eligible.message: Your goods qualify for the Windsor Framework green lane (B2B). With a valid UKIMS authorisation you can move them on the green lane.

UKIMS present but one or more commodity codes missing — manual review required
